name: Ren Min
bio: Ren Min graduated from the High School Affiliated to Beijing Dance Academy and is currently enrolled in the 2016 undergraduate class of the Performance Department of the Central Academy of Drama.

credits.title: Bureau 749
credits.overview: A traumatized young man with physical abnormalities is forced to join a mysterious bureau to confront a disaster spreading across the earth caused by an unknown creature. He embarks on an adventure uncovering mysteries about his life.

credits.title: Stay With Me
credits.overview: Zhao Yiyi has been secretly in love with Xu Jiashu. She is finally able to confess her love after the college entrance exams and they start a long-distance relationship that tests their love for each other throughout the years.

credits.title: Ten Years of Loving You
credits.overview: Ten years ago, Wen Heng, who was fostered in a water town in the south of the Yangtze River, was taken back to Wen's northern house for the first time. There she met Yanxi. Their life is entangled together, life path taking them separate ways and together again.

credits.title: Cry Me a Sad River
credits.overview: Qi Ming is a handsome boy and he is also a top student at school, but Yi Yao is a so-called bitch on everyone’s lips. Qi and Yi grew up together and they have been maintaining a good relationship. However, everything is interrupted and changed by Tang Xiaomi. Rumors have become a sharp weapon to destroy people. credits.title: Chongqing Hot Pot
credits.overview: When three friends open a hot pot restaurant in a former bomb shelter, they discover it’s linked by a single wall to the bank vault next door.  While deciding to take the easy money or go to the police, they find out one of the bank’s employees is a former classmate and look to enlist her in deciding their future.
